DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再検査の案内についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 健診代は払いました。この紙が来たので、同じ検査をまた払う請求だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再検査案内を二重請求と思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bayad na po ang checkup. Nang dumating ang papel, akala ko singil uli sa parehong pagsusuri.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong sa pag-aakalang duplicate bill ang re-exam notice. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙の目的と、今後の検査の内容を担当が確認します。請求と決めず見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titiyakin ng staff ang layunin at susunod na pagsusuri. Huwag ituring agad na bill; ipakita.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額の欄はありませんでした。再検査の案内と支払済み領収書を別に見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内と領収書を別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Wala po palang amount field. Pakitingnan nang hiwalay ang re-exam notice at paid receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita nang hiwalay ang notice at resibo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診療については医療職が説明します。費用条件も別に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Medical professional ang magpapaliwanag ng pagsusuri. Hiwalay ding matitiyak ang gastos.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 費用が分からないから再検査不要と判断せず、内容と費用をそれぞれ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 費用不明だけで不要と決めず内容と費用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po ituturing na hindi kailangan dahil hindi alam ang gastos. Parehong nilalaman at presyo ang itatanong.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag ituring na hindi kailangan dahil sa presyo at itanong ang nilalaman at gastos. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。予約はされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ituturo ng staff. May appointment na?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。紙が届いただけで日時が取れたとは考えず、予約方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未予約を伝え日時の取り方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wala pa po. Hindi sapat na may dumating na papel para may oras; itatanong din ang booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing wala pang booking at itanong ang pagkuha ng oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では内容、費用、予約の順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nilalaman, gastos at booking ang sunod nating titiyakin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。健診の支払いとは分けて説明を聞き、必要な対応を担当と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三事項を元健診の支払いと分け担当に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Hiwalay sa unang checkup payment ang paliwanag at kukonsultahin ang kailangang gawin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang tatlo sa dating bayad at kumonsulta sa staff. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの資料を持って担当へどうぞ。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 区画の確認でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内写真の二十三番へ置きました。写真に出ているので私の場所だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配置例写真の番号へ駐輪したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa 23 po sa larawan ko ipinarada. Akala ko akin dahil nasa guide photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang parking sa numero ng example photo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は配置の例です。ご自身の契約区画は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Example lamang ang larawan. Hiwalay ang sarili ninyong contracted space.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書を持っています。写真と違う番号があるので、こちらで照合してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書の番号で照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: May kontrata po. Iba ang numerong naroon; pakitugma rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hilinging itugma sa contract number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約番号はこちらです。すでに二十三番へ置いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang contract number. Nasa 23 na po?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。間違いに気づいたので、隣の自転車を動かさず、自分の物を移す手順を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の自転車を動かさず自分の移動手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Napansin ang mali kaya hindi gagalawin ang katabing bike; pakituro ang paglilipat ng akin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag ilipat ang bike ng iba at itanong ang sariling paglipat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の状態を係が確認します。鍵はご自身で持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan ng staff ang lugar. Hawak ninyo ang susi?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。契約区画に物があっても勝手に移さず係へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵を示し契約区画の他人の物も自己移動しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hawak po. Kung may gamit sa contracted space, hindi ko sariling ililipat at magsasabi sa staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang susi at huwag sariling ilipat ang gamit sa contracted space. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係と一緒に場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabay sa staff tingnan ang lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。写真の例ではなく契約番号で、自分の自転車だけ移して正しい位置を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 係と契約番号で自転車を正しい位置へ移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Contract number at hindi photo example ang batayan; sarili kong bike lang ang ililipat at titiyakin ang tamang puwesto.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ilipat sa tamang lugar kasama ang staff at contract number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では現地へご案内します。契約書もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Igagabay sa lugar. Dalhin ang kontrata.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 夕食の希望を確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Natiyak na ba ang gustong hapunan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族は魚を希望しましたが、ご本人は別の料理と話しました。家族の希望で確定してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族と本人の異なる夕食希望を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Isda po ang gusto ng pamilya pero ibang lutuin ang sinabi ng mismong tao. Maaari bang pamilya ang pinal?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat ang magkaibang dinner choices ng pamilya at tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの希望を分けて報告してください。本人の話を消して確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay iulat ang bawat gusto. Huwag burahin ang sinabi niya para ikumpirma.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人は肉を希望しました。食べられる条件まで自分が判断したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人希望を示し食事適合は未判断と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Karne po ang gusto niya. Hindi ako ang nagpasya pati sa angkop na pagkain.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang sariling hiling niya at hindi pa napagpasyahang suitability. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食事の条件は担当が確認します。変更は厨房へ伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin sa kondisyon. Nasabi na ang pagbabago sa kusina?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。二つの希望と未変更の状態を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 厨房未変更と双方の希望を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa po. Parehong gusto at hindi pa binago ang ipapasa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipasa ang parehong gusto at hindi pa binagong kusina. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人へ確認する時も、無理に家族と同じ答えを求めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa pagtatanong sa kanya, huwag piliting pareho ang sagot sa pamilya.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族の言葉を先に繰り返して誘導せず、本人が話した希望をそのまま記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誘導せず本人の発言を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Hindi ko uulitin muna ang pamilya para impluwensiyahan; eksaktong hiling niya ang itatala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag impluwensiyahan at itala ang sinabi mismo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に担当が食事の扱いを案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos matiyak, staff ang magtuturo ng pagkain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。希望の出所と今の注文状態を引き継ぎ、厨房への変更は指示が出てから行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出所と注文状態を示し変更指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Ipapaalam ang source at order status at sa utos pa babaguhin sa kusina.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang pinagmulan at status at hintayin ang change instruction. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報で確認します。まだ食事は変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Gagamitin iyan sa pagtiyak. Huwag munang baguhin ang pagkain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日出した荷物に部屋番号を書き忘れました。新しいラベルを作れば前の荷物も直りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送済み荷物を新ラベルだけで訂正できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nakalimutan ko po ang room number sa parcel kahapon. Maitatama ba ang nauna kung gumawa ng bagong label?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung sapat ang bagong label para sa naipadalang parcel. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送済みの荷物の扱いは、番号と状況を確認します。新しいラベルだけで直ったとはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa naipadala, numero at status ang titiyakin. Hindi itinuturing na naitama sa bagong label lang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の控えを見せます。まだ同じ品をもう一つ送ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを示し重複未発送を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ipapakita ko po ang kopya kahapon. Hindi pa ako nagpapadala ng ikalawang kapareho.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang kopya at sabihing wala pang duplicate shipping. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の状況と相談できる手順を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin sa status at puwedeng hakbang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返送されたと決めつけず待ちます。相手には部屋番号が抜けた可能性を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返送断定を避け相手へ記入不足を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Maghihintay po nang hindi ipinapalagay na returned. Sasabihin sa tatanggap ang posibleng kulang na room.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag tiyaking returned at ipaalam ang kulang sa tatanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正したい住所も、受取人へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin din sa recipient ang gustong itamang address.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人から完全な住所を確認しました。控えの番号と、新しい住所メモを別に示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 完全住所を本人に確認し控えと別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Natiyak ko po sa kanya ang kumpleto. Hiwalay ang copy number at bagong address memo na ipapakita.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin sa tao ang buong address at ipakita nang hiwalay sa kopya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へその二つをお持ちください。対応ができるとここでは確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Dalhin ang dalawa. Hindi pa tiyak dito ang magagawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。元の荷物の状況を確認してから対応を決め、同じ物を重ねて送りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原荷物状況確認前の重複発送を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Status muna ng nauna bago magpasya; hindi ako uulit ng kaparehong padala.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iwasan ang duplicate bago matiyak ang orihinal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では発送済みの番号で確認します。

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お求めのサイズはこちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito po bang size ang gusto?

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 展示の靴を買います。箱に戻せば試着されていない品になると思いました。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱へ戻すと未試着品になると思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bibilhin ko ang display shoes. Akala ko kapag ibinalik sa kahon ay hindi pa nasubukan.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang nagiging untried kapag ibinalik sa box. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱に入れることと試着履歴は別です。販売する品の状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang paglalagay sa kahon at history ng pagsukat. Tingnan ang sale condition.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 未試着と言えると思い込んでいました。展示品か別在庫かを教えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示品と別在庫の区別を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po maituturing na hindi nasubukan. Pakisabi kung display o ibang stock.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang display at ibang stock. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材では展示品としての販売です。状態を見てご検討ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa materyal na ito, display item ang benta. Tingnan at pag-isipan.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左右とも見たいです。片方の見た目だけで同じ状態とは判断しません。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左右の状態を個別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto ko pong makita pareho. Hindi ko ihuhulang parehong kondisyon mula sa isa.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suriin nang hiwalay ang kaliwa at kanan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 左右をお見せします。対応条件も確認できます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapakita ang dalawa. Matitiyak rin ang response conditions.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かかとの状態が気になるので、購入前にその部分と販売条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 気になるかかとと販売条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Napansin ko po ang heel kaya pakisabi ang bahaging iyon at sale conditions bago bumili.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang heel at sale conditions. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が説明します。別在庫の有無も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng staff. Titiyakin din ang ibang stock?

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。状態と条件を聞き、別在庫の確認後にどちらを買うか決めます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態条件と別在庫確認後に購入判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Kalagayan at kondisyon muna, pati ibang stock, bago piliin ang bibilhin.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya matapos ang kondisyon at ibang stock check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では確認します。今は購入確定にせずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin. Maghintay nang hindi pinal ang pagbili.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この部品は試作品として扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Prototype ang paghawak sa piyesang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 形が同じなので、量産の完成品の箱へ入れて数を増やしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試作品を同形量産品に含められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pareho po ang hugis; maaari bang isama sa production finished box para madagdagan ang bilang?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maisasama ang prototype sa kahugis na production. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試作品と量産品は分けます。同じ形だけで混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang prototype at production. Huwag pagsamahin dahil hugis lang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ混ぜていません。試作の識別と置場を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未混入と伝え識別置場を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po naisama. Pakituro ang prototype identification at puwesto.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi nahalo at itanong ang identification at storage. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が識別票と専用の置場を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang magpapakita ng ID tag at dedicated area.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 専用の場所に置きます。量産の目標数にも含めないことを記録で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 専用置場と目標数の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Doon po ilalagay. Gusto kong matiyak sa record na hindi rin kasama sa production target.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang dedicated area at target count. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 集計の扱いも担当が確認します。今の表へ書き込みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff din ang magtitingin sa tally. Naisulat na sa kasalukuyang table?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一個として書きかけましたが、まだ提出していません。変更箇所を担当へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未提出の集計書込みを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nagsimula po akong magsulat ng isa pero hindi pa naisumite. Ipapakita sa staff ang papalitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang hindi pa naisumiteng tally writing. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部品と表を合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabay tingnan ang piyesa at table.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。試作品を分けた状態で、識別票と集計の訂正を確認して引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試作品の識別と訂正を確認して引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hiwalay ang prototype habang tinitiyak ang ID at tally correction bago ipasa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang prototype ID at correction bago ipasa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではその状態でお待ちください。量産箱へは入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maghintay nang ganoon. Huwag ilagay sa production box.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてのお尋ねですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の品には値引きシールがあります。同じ種類なので、こちらにも貼り替えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同種商品の値引きシールを移せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: May discount sticker sa katabi. Pareho po ang uri; puwede bang ilipat dito ang sticker?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maililipat ang discount sticker ng parehong uri. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: シールを移さないでください。値引き対象はそれぞれ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag ilipat. Bawat discount target ay hiwalay titiyakin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。同じ種類なら同じ価格になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と同価格と思った誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko pa po hinawakan. Akala ko pareho ang presyo basta parehong uri.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi nahawakan at inakalang pareho ang presyo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象や商品の条件は担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Matatanong sa staff ang target at kondisyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの期限も見たいです。値引きの有無だけで中身の条件まで同じとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限と内容を値引きから別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto ko ring makita ang petsa nito. Hindi discount lang ang batayan na pareho ang loob.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hiwalay sa discount ang petsa at laman. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの表示を見て選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan ang label ng bawat isa bago pumili.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの期限と内容を比べます。シールを移さず、値引き表示のある方を買うか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示を移さず二商品の条件で比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ihahambing ko po ang dalawang petsa at laman. Hindi ililipat ang sticker; pag-iisipang bilhin ang may label.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ilipat ang label at ihambing ang dalawang kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どちらになさいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期限を確認して値引き表示のある一つにします。別の品へ割引を移す希望は取り下げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した表示付き商品を選び貼替え希望をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak ang petsa kaya isang may discount label. Hindi ko na hinihiling ilipat sa iba ang diskuwento.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang natiyak na may label at itigil ang pagpapalipat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では表示のある商品をそのままレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dalhin sa cashier nang ganoon ang may label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは実験の見学席です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Obserbasyon po ng eksperimento ang mga upuang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券があるので、自分で装置を動かす体験だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見学券を操作体験券と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: May ticket po kaya akala ko ako ang magpapatakbo ng aparato.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inakalang operation experience ticket ang viewing ticket. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この券は見学用です。操作する体験の案内とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Pangtingin ito, hiwalay sa operation experience guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ操作台へ入っていません。見学で何を見られるか説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未立入と伝え見学内容を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po pumasok sa control area. Pakipaliwanag kung ano ang mapapanood.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pumasok at itanong ang viewing contents. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係の実演と説明をご覧いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Demonstrasyon at paliwanag ng staff ang panonoorin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実演を見て同じ装置を自由に使えるとは考えません。操作体験があるか別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演後の自由操作を前提にせず別体験を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping malayang magagamit matapos manood. Hiwalay kong itatanong kung may hands-on experience.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag asahang malayang gamitin at itanong ang hiwalay na experience. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象や受付方法は案内で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa guide ang eligibility at registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず今の見学をします。操作体験へ勝手に券を使い回さず、別の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現券を操作へ流用せずまず見学する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Panoorin ko po muna. Hindi basta gagamitin ang parehong ticket sa operation; ibang kondisyon ang itatanong.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag gamitin ang kasalukuyang ticket sa operation at manood muna. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実演中は指定の席でご覧ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。見学席で説明を聞き、操作を希望する時は別の受付を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定席で実演を見て別受付を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Dito pakikinggan at kung gusto ang operation, ibang registration ang titiyakin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Manood sa designated seat at tiyakin ang ibang registration. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの席へどうぞ。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車はお二人ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この券に二つの欄があるので、一枚で二人分だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復二欄を二人分と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. May dalawang field kaya akala ko pangdalawa ang isang ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inakalang dalawang tao ang two-way fields. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は往路と復路です。人数分とは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Outgoing at return ang fields. Hiwalay sa bilang ng tao.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つの移動方向の欄でしたか。友人の分はまだ買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復と人数を区別し友人未購入を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Dalawang direksiyon po pala. Hindi pa binili ang sa kaibigan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang round-trip at tao at sabihing wala pang ticket ang kaibigan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の券の条件と、追加購入の方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin ang kondisyon ng kasalukuyan at pagbili ng dagdag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の復路を友人の往路へ使うのでなく、二人の乗車条件を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 復路を他人の往路へ流用せず二人の条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po gagawing outbound niya ang return ko; pakitiyak ang conditions ng dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag gamitin ang return bilang outbound ng iba at itanong ang dalawa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人の券を担当が案内します。帰りの予定は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff ang magtuturo ng tiket ng kaibigan. Pareho ang balik?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは別の時間かもしれません。二人一緒に戻ると決めず、それぞれの券で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別帰路時刻の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Baka magkaibang oras po. Hindi ipapalagay na sabay; bawat tiket ang titiyakin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang posibleng ibang return time. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用条件と当日の運行案内を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tingnan ang use conditions at operations ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の往復券は保持し、友人の券と帰りの予定を別に確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分券を維持し友人券と帰りを別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Itatago ang round-trip ko at hiwalay titiyakin ang ticket niya at balik bago sumakay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang sariling ticket at hiwalay tiyakin ang kaibigan at balik. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では追加購入の窓口をご案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の収穫対象は作業表で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sa work sheet tiyakin ang harvest targets ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一番の札から順に収穫すればよいと思いました。区画の番号が作業順ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試験区番号を収穫順か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po sunod sa label isa ang ani. Work order ba ang plot numbers?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung harvest order ang experimental plot number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その札は試験区の識別です。収穫順番ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Experimental plot ID ang label, hindi harvest sequence.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ収穫していません。区画番号と今日の対象を作業表で合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未収穫と伝え作業表で対象照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi pa po nag-aani. Gusto kong itugma sa sheet ang plot at targets ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang ani at hilinging itugma ang targets sa sheet. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この表の対象だけです。試験区へ自己判断で入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Nasa table lang ang target. Huwag sariling pumasok sa experimental plot.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 対象を確認します。試験区の実が大きくても、収穫できる印とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実の大きさを収穫許可と考えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Titiyakin po. Kahit malaki ang bunga, hindi ko ituturing na harvest permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag ituring na harvest permission ang laki. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。収穫用の容器も指定を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Tiyakin din ang itinakdang harvest container.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 試験区の観察用の箱とは分けます。今日の収穫物に使う容器を示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 観察用箱と収穫容器を分け指定を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ihihiwalay po sa observation box. Pakituro ang lalagyan ng ani ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang observation box at harvest container at itanong ang designated. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの指定容器です。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。対象区画と容器を確認し、試験区の物を混ぜず指示された範囲で始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区画と容器を確認し対象範囲で始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Plot at container muna ang titiyakin; hindi ihahalo ang experimental at sa utos na saklaw magsisimula.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang plot at container at magsimula sa saklaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、作業表の対象から案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Mula sa targets sa work sheet ang gabay.
